name: smart-nutrient-control-panel
description: Smart Nutrient Advisor: the control panel app (app/) with its back end, simulator and config packs. npm install, then npm run dev, starts the back end in Docker and runs the app on it; npm run dev:demo runs the app on its fake API.

scripts.dev: node scripts/control-panel/backend.mjs && npm --prefix app run dev -- --mode real
